source_note: Hand-built sample set — real, currently-existing course titles and providers, written from general knowledge (not scraped or fetched live). Fallback for the missing Coursera/Udemy MCP connectors, per user instruction. Treat as representative, not verbatim listings. estimated_hours is a rough hand estimate for path-fitting purposes, not a scraped/official figure. Added for the multi-role rework (see CLAUDE.md) alongside seed_data_scientist.json and seed_ml_engineer.json.

courses.title: Meta Front-End Developer Professional Certificate
courses.description: A multi-course program covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and version control with Git, aimed at learners with no prior web development background.

courses.title: The Complete Web Developer Bootcamp
courses.description: A broad introduction to web development covering HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals through hands-on projects.

courses.title: React - The Complete Guide (incl. Hooks, React Router, Redux)
courses.description: Covers building React applications from scratch: components, hooks, routing, and state management with Redux and the Context API.

courses.title: Programming with TypeScript
courses.description: Covers TypeScript's type system, interfaces, and generics for learners already comfortable with JavaScript.

courses.title: Responsive Web Design Masterclass
courses.description: Covers building layouts that adapt across screen sizes using CSS Flexbox, Grid, and media queries.

courses.title: Introduction to Web Accessibility
courses.description: Covers WCAG guidelines, semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, and testing techniques for building accessible web pages.

courses.title: Next.js & React - The Complete Guide
courses.description: Covers building server-rendered and statically-generated React applications with Next.js, including routing and API routes.

courses.title: Git and GitHub Bootcamp
courses.description: Covers version control fundamentals with Git and collaborative workflows on GitHub, including branching and pull requests.

courses.title: Testing React Applications with Jest and React Testing Library
courses.description: Covers writing unit and integration tests for React components using Jest and React Testing Library.

courses.title: JavaScript Algorithms and Data Structures
courses.description: Covers core algorithms and data structures implemented in JavaScript, building a foundation for technical interviews and cleaner code.
